# the contributor full audit of the exact R4 all-normal depth certificate

Source: `candidate de93c4f08837e128`,
Sections1--9. Verdict: PASS. This is an actual exact depth computation
and auxiliary-profile obstruction, not an OC counterexample or proof.

Independent base and continuous vertex permutations preserve the actual
integer set and fiber area. Sorting their centered triples and positive
scaling exhausts every nonzero normal. The base triple refers to the
primitive vertices e1,e2,(-1,-1); a+h0=1 therefore normalizes one quarter
of the maximal D4 vertex value plus the maximal continuous vertex value.
This wording correction is in the final source/interface. The parameter
domain is exactly the displayed tetrahedron, including pure-base and
pure-continuous faces.

I independently substituted its barycentric coordinates: twice every
actual fiber margin equals f_j, and the ordered differences are g0,g1,g2,
all nonnegative. The triangle cap formula follows from similar-corner
areas and the full/empty identities. The raw lower bound40/3 is thus
equivalent, for distinct continuous heights, to S=3N-40g0g1g2>=0.
All doubled factors cancel in this homogeneous cubic equation.

The local polynomial replacement is genuinely a LOWER bound. Positive
uncertain terms may be dropped. A negative uncertain positive-part
square may be replaced by its full negative square. The signs of the
g coefficients justify both operations. Linear vertex sign tests hold
throughout each tetrahedron. Unnormalized integer-ray vertices multiply
each cubic coefficient by a common positive product of vertex sums.

I read both implementations. The search polarization gives3 times the
Bernstein coefficient of S, or9 times that of N-(40/3)D. The standalone
verifier independently expands the lower cubic in the power basis.
the contributor reran it successfully:

    525779 exact checks;
    11188 nonnegative cubic leaves;
    3911 disjoint covering splits;
    15099 total nodes; maximum depth15.

Each split's children lie in the parent, have pairwise disjoint interiors
certified by separating facet planes, and sum to its exact rational
volume. The finite child union is closed. Any missing parent point
would have a relative neighborhood missing that union and containing
positive parent volume, a contradiction. Coverage therefore includes
all boundaries. Every record is reached exactly once, every required
child has a record, and no leaf is pending. The source SHA-256 hashes
for the tree and verifier match the actual files exactly.

Repeated nonzero continuous heights follow by bounded convergence,
since every limiting line has zero fiber area. At pure-base normals,
the pointwise limsup of perturbed closed indicators is at most the
limiting CLOSED indicator. Reverse Fatou gives limiting closed mass
at least the limsup perturbed masses, retaining every boundary fiber.
Moving a strictly containing halfspace to the actual source only
decreases captured mass. Thus all ambient containing halfspaces are
covered with the exact constant.

The three explicit common-mass caps cover the ambient space, yielding
the matching global upper bound. Uniqueness also holds: any deepest
point must be on every critical cap boundary, since a strict interior
point survives a small threshold increase which removes positive area.
All margins then vanish. Their integer base offsets force barycentric
coordinates1/3 and base0. Hence(0,g) is the unique deepest point.

Combined with the separately audited144-edge martingale, this proves
that a genuine critical profile has full convex-potential optimum
40/93<4/9 despite strict proper-closed-minor count quotas. Its true
depth is far above OC's target1/9. The low bad-depth and attained-minimum
premises remain untested. Two-sided independently audited and replayed
the full certificate as well; this root PASS is not based only on that
verdict.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
